raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 4972 rows but only 4827 distinct txn_ids, and the ids are contiguous. So the extra rows are re-delivered copies of the same transactions across daily batches, and silver_transactions has no dedup step. I could not see the duplicate rows themselves, so I assumed the latest delivery per txn_id is the correct version.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
